story:
Patriot Metal Products Inc. is a multiple process custom coater, offering cost effective solutions for a variety of industries — automotive, metal, furniture, agricultural equipment, fasteners, appliances and many more. Our highly qualified and experienced staff is dedicated to serving the needs of our customers. Each year we look to continued growth while maintaining the confidence and needs of those customers.

The company was established and incorporated in Berwick, Pennsylvania in 1986. With experience spanning four decades, PMP has provided its customers with the quality and service they demand and deserve. Over the years the company has expanded its coating capacity from powder coating and zinc plating to now include the latest Autophoretic auto-deposition process.

Autophoretic, or A-coat as it is commonly called, is approved by the automotive, agricultural equipment and furniture industries. The process is streamlined and can coat more than a truckload of components per shift, which ensures the quick turnaround our customers require. Our dip coating process was added in 2004; for large quantities of product it is a very cost-effective coating process, and we can dip paint most any color where feasible.

Sixteen robotic spray guns assist manual spray operations in our powder coating process, and a drive-in batch spray room and curing process was added to accommodate specialized and larger items. All of our processes at Patriot Metal Products are supported with a state of the art coating laboratory, which allows us to certify both the process and the performance criteria our customers' specifications call for.

We understand the value of customer relationships and work hard to earn that trust with an ongoing commitment. PMP is proud to use green technology where available — including a powder re-claim unit that improves efficiency and lowers customer cost — and is always taking great strides to further our environmentally friendly practices.
